subject: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Comprehensive Permit
overview: The board reviewed updated architecture and engineering peer review reports for a proposed 350-unit development. The session focused on technical revisions to site logistics, fire safety, and bicycle parking ahead of a scheduled technical working session.

items.title: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway (Case 40B-2022-01)
items.summary: Continued the hearing to April 24, 2023, following a review of peer reports concerning stormwater management, site congestion, and building facade articulation. The applicant presented an expanded plan for 132 bicycle parking spaces and discussed fire safety coordination, while the board scheduled a technical working session for April 20 to resolve outstanding documentation issues.
